tools.name: recta_service_descriptor
tools.description: Call to check whether a planned cross-chain transfer is covered: the supported corridors (source and destination networks and assets), the bridges compared (Across, CCTP, Stargate, USDT0 and others), amount ranges, limits and the JSON Schema of every request and response.

tools.name: recta_prepare_signed_request
tools.description: Step 1 of a free quote for a cross-chain transfer. Computes the exact message the agent's EVM wallet must sign (EIP-191 personal_sign) for one Recta request, and the headers to send. Holds no key and calls nothing. Then call recta_send_signed_request with the same method, path, idempotency_key, body
